source_audits.source_name: NYC Health + Hospitals official press releases
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City public hospital and Gotham Health facilities
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: facility name and address/campus context; no room-level geometry
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Official NYC Health + Hospitals webpage; reuse of text/images is subject to NYC Health + Hospitals site terms/copyright. Candidate pack uses factual metadata and attribution only.
source_audits.reliability: High for announced facility, suite, and room milestones; not a clinical outcome or utilization source.
required_caveats: Record only observed facility or room changes.
Do not infer health outcomes, access changes, or service impacts from facility openings.
Geometry is an address/campus point, not a room or suite footprint.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Ingest as documented public health facility architecture/interior milestone with strict non-outcome caveats.
